description: GHS-BUILT-C is an open dataset on Amazon S3 listed in Registry of Open Data on AWS (urban, water, hazard and energy tags), a registry of open datasets hosted on Amazon S3 under the section "urban, cities", published or maintained by JRC. The spatial raster dataset delineates the boundaries of the human settlements at 10m resolution, and describe their inner characteristics in terms of the morphology of the built environment and the functional use. The Morphological Settlement Zone (MSZ) delineates the spatial domain of all the human settlements at the neighboring scale of approx. Coverage: as stated on the registry page. The registry lists it under the tags urban, cities and hosts it on Amazon S3. Update frequency: NA. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 (as given on the registry page). Caveats: this record was written from the registry page, which was read; the data on S3 were not opened, the licence text was shortened, and the description may lag the source. It can support data-driven infrastructure planning and analysis. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-registry-of-open-data-on-aws-urban-water-hazard-tags.
